page.notes: Printed "Eclipsis" with long s, given as Eclipsis. "dutis" is uncertain and may be read as "debitis"; left as printed in appearance but unverified. Italic/roman distinction in the prayer (e.g. "Columna", "Ignis") is inferred from the scan and may be imperfect. The paragraph at the foot continues onto the next page. Fragment "gis" at the top is a line-start fragment and stays as is. Show-through and edge marks on the left and right margins are omitted.
